title: 理论溯源与进化时间线
subtitle: The Genesis · From Social Diagnosis to Ecosystemic Intervention
description: 从单一病理诊断到多维生态嵌套：系统梳理社会工作生态系统理论跨越八十年的范式跃迁脉络。

nodes.title: 玛丽·里士满《社会诊断》
nodes.author: Mary E. Richmond
nodes.coreContribution: 首次在社会工作领域确立"人在情境中"(Person-in-Situation)的分析框架，标志社工从纯慈善救济转向系统诊断思维。
nodes.paradigmShift: 从"个人道德缺陷归因"转向"社会因素介入归因"，为后续系统论植入预留理论接口。
quotes: "Social work is the art of doing good scientifically."
"The first step in social case work is diagnosis."

nodes.title: 赫恩引入一般系统论
nodes.author: Edgar H. Hearn
nodes.publication: General Systems Theory and Social Casework
nodes.coreContribution: 将贝塔朗菲(Ludwig von Bertalanffy)的生物学"一般系统论"跨界移植至社会工作，提出"全人"(Whole Person)概念。
nodes.paradigmShift: 打破医学模式下的线性因果思维，确立"系统大于部分之和"的整体论视角。
quotes: "The individual cannot be understood in isolation from the systems in which he lives."
"Wholeness is not reducible to the sum of its parts."

nodes.title: 平卡斯与米纳汉四大基本系统
nodes.author: Allen Pincus & Ann Minahan
nodes.publication: Social Work Practice: Model and Method
nodes.coreContribution: 确立系统论在社工实务中可操作的四大基本系统：改变媒介系统、案主系统、目标系统、行动系统。
nodes.paradigmShift: 完成从抽象理论到实务流程的转化，系统论从此具备可训练、可评估的操作框架。
keyConcepts: 改变媒介系统 (Change Agent System)
quotes: "Four systems constitute the conceptual framework of all social work practice."
"The change agent must map all four systems before any intervention."

nodes.title: 布朗芬布伦纳生态嵌套模型
nodes.author: Urie Bronfenbrenner
nodes.coreContribution: 提出"微系统-中系统-外系统-宏系统-历时系统"的同心圆嵌套模型，为系统层级提供精准拓扑定义；四个系统之间存在交互耦合的联系与影响，人的发展来自人与环境的持续相互作用（Bronfenbrenner, 1979；刘杰 & 孟会敏, 2009）。
nodes.paradigmShift: 从"并列系统"升级为"嵌套层级系统"，干预空间从二维平面拓展至三维立体结构。
quotes: "Development occurs through progressively more complex interactions between the developing person and the environment."
"Every system contains other systems, and is contained by still larger ones."

nodes.title: 杰曼与吉特曼生命模式
nodes.author: Carel B. Germain & Alex Gitterman
nodes.publication: The Life Model of Social Work Practice
nodes.coreContribution: 整合生态学视角与生命周期理论，提出"生活压力源三维分类"与"社工角色三阶段流转"，标志生态系统理论实务模式成熟（Germain & Gitterman, 1980）。
nodes.paradigmShift: 社工角色从"治疗者"彻底转向"联结修复者"，干预目标从"修复个人"转变为"提升人与环境的契合度"。
keyConcepts: 使能者-中介者-倡导者 (Enabler → Mediator → Advocate)
quotes: "The goal of social work is to improve the fit between people and their environments."
"Social workers do not fix people—they repair the connections between people and the systems that sustain them."

epilogue.title: Pardeck 七步干预法与后续演进
epilogue.summary: 1996年John T. Pardeck将上述脉络整合为七步生态干预流程，同时数字社会工作研究开始关注算法生态排斥、线上社会资本等新变量，理论仍在持续演进中。
epilogue.nextModuleTeaser: 下一模块：核心假设与力学拆解 — 将三大底层假设转化为可交互的受力分析拓扑图。
